answer: Locks are logged in dune, expire in plume, and voyage lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 192 aliases thus needs 80 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4140 identities would post 2247 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
